content.value: A Kaplan turbine produces 9x 104 kW under a head of 30 m with an overall efficiency of 85%. The hub diameter is 4 times the outer diameter of the runner. Determine (i) diameters, (ii) the speed of the turbine assuming the speed ratio Ku = 1.5 and flow ratio= 0.65.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year Special Backlog Examination, 2021
